decision.instructions: Is this edit part of carrying out the user's stated task? The user need not have named the file; answer no only when the edit is clearly unrelated to the task.

positive.message: The edit serves the user's stated task.

negative.message: This edit appears unrelated to your stated task; approve it only if you intended it.

uncertain.message: The edit scope is uncertain; ask before proceeding.

missing_evidence.message: The edit is held because its target is missing or outside the workspace.
missing_evidence.reminder: Keep edits inside the current workspace.

judge_failure.message: Chauffeur could not judge this edit; ask before proceeding.

cooldown.message: Unused: this contract has no cooldown.
